cases.prompt: Fix a typo in a localized UI label.
assertions: Chooses direct work
Does not create ceremonial agents
Verifies the changed surface

cases.prompt: On Plus, build a polished room planner with synchronized 2D and 3D views and browser-test the result.
assertions: When delegation is authorized and available, considers a small coordinator with one continuing Astra implementation worker
Preserves the original product brief
Coordinator tests and sends screenshots with concrete failures
Does not route all creative implementation to Luna

cases.prompt: On Pro, plan and implement a multi-service application with difficult integration and migration risk.
assertions: Uses Astra judgment for planning and consequential decisions
Does not assume small coordinator is sufficient
Assigns required integration and safety checks

cases.prompt: Build a high-stakes, hard-to-test workflow where correctness is more important than usage.
assertions: Prefers direct or Astra-led work
Does not trade away required verification for cost

cases.prompt: Optimize model usage on a bounded frontend, but this environment does not permit subagents.
assertions: Does not spawn agents
Uses a direct capable route
Does not claim a delegated cost saving

cases.prompt: The first delegated product build has a clipping bug at 1100x760 and broken selection; screenshot attached.
assertions: Returns evidence to the existing worker thread if useful
Does not prescribe a speculative technical fix
Continues until acceptance passes or reports a blocker

cases.prompt: Will this routing definitely halve my Plus quota consumption?
assertions: Does not equate API-equivalent cost with ChatGPT quota
Treats two examples as limited evidence
Suggests matched workload evaluation
